summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge: analyze Soony's confidential launch data, find hidden risks the plan says are 'ok', and build a product (Lighthouse/ask-soony) that rechecks and acts on new data drops, then polish the UI before the 12:45 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses Sunday (overbooked art-book receipt, failed statue lot, game cards short) and built a poller, agent loop and web app with demo/live servers. Merged and polished the 'How we got here' case flow, routine step menu, top bar, phone layout and key hints, and swapped in the variant 3 lighthouse logo; the case list animation was in progress. `main` was about 21 commits ahead of origin and not pushed.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) with no notifications or webhooks; changes are detected by polling and comparing SHA-256, and existing files get replaced under the same name.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored `data/`; `.env` is gitignored and `.env.example` is committed, with `SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN` required or the API returns 401.
The API server does not load `.env` on import; settings such as `ASK_VIEWER_TITLE` must be read through a helper that loads `.env` first or they are missing after restart.

Routine steps are only valid for certain watch kinds: 'Chase once if no answer' needs routines watching messages waiting for an answer, 'Ask for a status' needs shipments; the server rejects them elsewhere ('step 2 cannot be done on open decisions').
Number keys 1-9 only choose an option; Cmd+Enter carries out the chosen one. Option 1 is pre-chosen, so its badge only matters when other options are open.

Case flow reuses the routine diagram's connector and node components exported from FlowGraph.tsx so the two stay visually consistent; the two-column snake layout was confusing and was replaced with a single top-to-bottom column.
Team workflow files (CLAUDE.md, PROGRESS.md) exist; tasks are claimed with a Now line in PROGRESS.md. Entire hooks only write a checkpoint when repo files change.
Live (:8000) needs a restart to pick up new server endpoints and settings, while the demo is restarted separately with state kept and email recorded only.

code.finding: New component rendering the 'How we got here' flow from each case's own data (agent steps, evidence, prediction, approval rule, options); omits steps the data lacks. Compact vs full mode with a Details/Less toggle remembered per device.
Source of the routine diagram's connector (Link) and node box styles, now exported and shared with CaseFlow.

workflow: Check the user's intent against the team's actual preference before building: the 'Describe it' chat was built when the team liked Pulse's flow view, and it had to be reverted.
Keep experimental UI on branches and screenshot at desktop and phone sizes before merging; user feedback via screenshots drove most fixes.
Delegate bulk document cross-checking (200 order confirmations, 59 scans) to a subagent and keep confidential data local and gitignored.
Interviews and office-hours notes in the repo (Sophia, Maren) are a useful source to settle UI/product direction disputes.
Use subagents for parallel design work such as drawing logo variants.

friction: Token was initially empty so no data could be pulled until the user supplied it.
Misread what the team liked in Pulse (chat vs flow view), leading to a merge that had to be undone.
Two-column snake flow read right-to-left on the second row and confused the user.
The top bar got crowded at narrower widths; the heartbeat was absolutely positioned and overlapped the status.
On phones the page auto-scrolled to the case list on load, and compact/full flow looked the same; the phone action bar overlapped the options.
The user interrupted a tool run mid-edit, and it was unclear whether the edit had applied (it had, as commit 762e9a8).
The hand-in time moved from 12:00 to 12:45 without the assistant knowing until the user said so.
The 'Ask Maren to approve' button jumping could not be reproduced.
Supplier-facing actions were blocked on registering sender addresses in portal Settings.
